524. Rotate Square Matrix 90 Degrees

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Querty is a decryption program which uses a key to decrypt security codes for ethical hacking. Querty is on the process of hacking into the server of a terrorist organisation. The decryption key is a square matrix consisting of positive integers. Querty has almost decrypted the security key and is just one step short of complete decryption. It has found the right values of the matrix elements but it needs to rotate the matrix by 90 degrees clockwise for complete decryption. Help querty to do the same.
input_spec:
First line contains dimensions of the matrix N*N
Next line contains the elements of the matrix.
output_spec: Matrix rotated by 90 degrees in clockwise direction
